Severe Storms Cause Damage in Ontario, Canada

Severe thunderstorms brought high winds and hail to parts of Ontario, Canada. In Brampton, strong winds tore the roof off a building. In Toronto, hail was observed bouncing off vehicles during the storm. The storms caused significant property damage.
